name: Paladin: RSVP Capacity and Waitlist
summary: Add seat limits, a waitlist and expiring seat offers to a small layered Node API, with tests.
prompt: We want seat limits and a waitlist in the Gatherly API. docs/waitlist.md has the behaviour we agreed on, and README.md explains how the app is put together. Please build it end to end and cover the new behaviour with tests under test/, in a new file; leave test/app.test.mjs as it is. Use only Node.js built-ins; do not install packages or use the network.

checks.label: Test suite passes with new feature tests
API matches the agreed waitlist behaviour
